# ARENOVA — FULL TECHNICAL AND ARCHITECTURAL MANIFEST

## Organization
- Entity: ARENOVA Systems Architecture & AI Automation
- Website: https://arenova.in
- Founder: Avi
- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Delivery: Global (United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India)
- Primary Positioning: AI Automation Agency, Custom AI Agent Development Company, Business Process Automation Agency

## Core Philosophy: Deterministic AI Systems
- Fundamental Axiom: "Language models interpret. Explicit rules, validation schemas, and APIs execute."
- Zero Hallucination Standard: Probabilistic LLMs are never granted direct, unvalidated write access to production databases or financial APIs. All model outputs must conform to typed Pydantic/Zod schemas before triggering downstream transactions.
- Exception Handling: Every automated workflow incorporates human-in-the-loop fallback gates for ambiguous inputs, edge cases, or low-confidence model predictions.

## Service Offerings & Specifications

### 1. AI Automation Agency (/services/ai-automation/)
- URL: https://arenova.in/services/ai-automation/

- Typical Outcomes: 75% reduction in manual data entry hours, sub-minute lead response times, zero dropped customer handoffs.

### 2. Custom AI Agent Development (/services/ai-agents/)
- URL: https://arenova.in/services/ai-agents/
- Frameworks: Python, LangGraph, Pydantic AI, LlamaIndex, pgvector, Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, Twilio.
- Architecture: 4-layer design comprising Perception/Intent Extraction, Multi-Step Planning Loop, Scoped Tool Execution, and Human Fallback Handover.

### B2B Professional Services (/industries/b2b-services/)
- Workflows: Client intake routing, automated proposal generation, DocuSign contract triggers, retainer overage monitoring, automated invoice reconciliation.

### Healthcare Administration (/industries/healthcare/)
- Workflows: Non-clinical patient appointment scheduling, calendar reminders, administrative triage, medical intake form collection. All medical advice is strictly excluded and routed to clinical staff.

### Recruitment & Staffing (/industries/recruitment/)
- Workflows: Resume parsing against role rubrics, WhatsApp candidate pre-screening, bidirectional ATS sync (Greenhouse, Lever, Bullhorn), and automated calendar booking.

### Marketing Agencies & Studios (/industries/marketing-agencies/)

### B2B SaaS & Platforms (/industries/saas/)

## Engineering Playbooks & Research Publications

### The Deterministic AI Playbook (/blog/deterministic-ai-playbook/)
- Deep engineering analysis on why 70% of Make & Zapier automations break at scale, and the dual-layer architecture (Perception vs. Execution) required for production.

### Autonomous AI Agents vs Traditional Chatbots (/blog/ai-agents-vs-chatbots/)
- Comprehensive systems comparison: Reactive RAG chatbots vs. goal-directed autonomous agents, four-subsystem agent architecture, and multi-agent coordination.

### Calculating Business Process Automation ROI (/blog/calculating-automation-roi/)
- Mathematical formulation of business automation return on investment: loaded labor equations, error rework multipliers, and payback velocity modeling.
